title: AXOLOTL'24 Shared Task on Multilingual Explainable Semantic Change Modeling

selection.evidence: The most recent sense-level LSC shared task before SemEval-2027 Task 3 (whose organisers include Fedorova); its data are the only public sense+gloss annotated diachronic sets in Russian, a Task 3 language. Opened to build arena-lsc's public dev pool.

cost.compute_notes: arXiv PDF main body pp. 1-8 read (data, organisation, results, discussion); appendices skimmed. Repository cloned (6ccddbb) and dev+test-gold of FI and RU converted to the SemEval-2027 Task 3 format and scored with that task's official scorer (controls) and with arena-lsc systems.

triggers: novel sense detection shared task Finnish Russian German
sense annotated diachronic Russian data with glosses
WSD vs WSI trade-off ARI vs F1 semantic change

claims.statement: Six teams; Subtask 1 (assign new-period usages to old glosses or novel senses) ranked separately by ARI and by macro-F1 on old senses. Deep-change (GlossReader WSD) best on average: ARI 41.3, F1 75.0 (Fi-Ru-De); it predicted no novel senses at all. Best Russian ARI was 13.2 (WooperNLP); the organisers' baseline (LEALLA + affinity propagation + 0.3 cosine threshold) had ARI 4.1, F1 20.7.
claims.scope: Two periods; Russian old usages come from Dal's dictionary and new ones from Wiktionary-based CoDWoE, mapped by hand; novel-sense share 14% FI, 21% DE, 57% RU.

our_assessment.why: The organisers themselves note the metric pathology: a pure WSD system that never detects a novel sense wins F1 and average ARI, because FI and DE have few novel senses. So the leaderboard rewards WSD with glosses, not change detection. Russian is effectively a different task (57% novel senses, two dictionaries spliced), where every system is near ARI 0.

claims.statement: Finnish target positions were verified manually for all dev and test sentences; Russian usages have no target offsets.

our_assessment.why: Confirmed on the files: converting dev+test-gold, FI needed 29 offset recoveries of 9,247 usages; RU needed 3,716 (every usage) by a stem-prefix locator and 185 could not be located. Anyone reusing RU must locate targets themselves (Deep-change used pymorphy2 word forms plus manual fixes).

checked.how: git clone --depth 1; python .claude/memory/maria/arena-lsc/tooling/convert_public.py axolotl <data/russian|data/finnish> <gold> --min-per-period 3|10; harness.py controls
checked.result: FI: 133 words with >= 10 usages per period, 9,207 usages; RU: 40 words with >= 3 per period, 606 usages (no word has 10 old usages, so no SemEval-2027-style 1b on RU)

open_questions: Does a GlossReader-style gloss-matching model transfer to SemEval-2027 Task 3 Subtask 2 (one definition, binary decision) in the six Task 3 languages?
